commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Mateo Busquets shows the yellow card to John Donald (Elche) for a heavy challenge.
90+4' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche), but it's just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
90+4' Elche have been awarded a corner kick.
90+2' A cross from a corner kick by Elche is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' Abderrahmane Rebbach will be replaced by Aitor Manas (Alaves).
89' Here is a change. German Valera is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Hector Fort (Elche).
88' The main referee, Mateo Busquets, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is given a yellow card for dissent.
88' Grady Diangana (Elche) was probably a bit loose with his words to Mateo Busquets, who decides to show him a yellow.
85' Victor Chust goes off the pitch and Buba Sangare (Elche) comes on.
85' Eder Sarabia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with John Donald (Elche) replacing Marc Aguado.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ibrahim Diabate departs the field of play to be replaced by Carlos Protesoni (Alaves).
82' Ander Guevara comes onto the pitch after Jon Guridi (Alaves) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
82' Referee Mateo Busquets has finally had enough of Eder Sarabia and brandishes a yellow card at him!
81' Josan (Elche) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
80' Jon Guridi (Alaves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
78' Josan (Elche) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
78' The statistic for corner kicks – 4:3.
78' Great teamplay by Elche as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
75' Josan (Elche) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The linesman signals a throw-in for Elche.

72' 1 - 1 Josan showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header down into the middle of the net. It's 1:1.
71' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Elche.
69' Today's referee Mateo Busquets rightly decides to book Ibrahim Diabate (Alaves) for his harsh tackle.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yusi is coming onto the pitch as Toni Martinez (Alaves) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
67' Eder Sarabia decides to make a substitution. Aleix Febas will be replaced by Grady Diangana (Elche).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Josan (Elche) comes onto the pitch for Tete Morente.
63' Jon Guridi (Alaves) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.

61' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) covers his face with his hands after wasting a glorious chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
60' Tete Morente (Elche) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
59' Elche are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception.
58' The Elche players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
54' The Elche players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
53' Elche will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
51' 0 - 1 Goal! Matias Dituro gets a hand on the penalty from Toni Martinez (Alaves), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
51' Toni Martinez (Alaves) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
50' A yellow card for a tackle by Aleix Febas (Elche). Mateo Busquets doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
50' Aleix Febas (Elche) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Alaves.
48' Elche concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
46' The attendance is 22936.
46' Quique Sanchez Flores prepares a substitution. Pablo Ibanez is replaced by Denis Suarez (Alaves).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' Angel Perez (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
41' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mateo Busquets no option but to blow his whistle.
41' Neat passing move from Elche in order to create new attacking opportunities.
37' Now Elche have a corner.
36' Wonderful movement by Elche. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

34' Victor Chust (Elche) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
33' Jonny Otto (Alaves) sees a yellow card from Mateo Busquets after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
29' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Mateo Busquets ignores the protests.
28' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 51:49.

27' Victor Parada (Alaves) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
27' Alaves enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
25' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Matias Dituro comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
22' The Elche players are exchanging some short passes.
21' Alaves play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. The ball is out of play. Alaves will have a throw-in.
19' The resulting corner from Victor Chust (Elche) comes to nothing.
18' Mateo Busquets interrupts the game. One of the players from Elche won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
17' Elche quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
14' Tete Morente (Elche) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
12' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) for a tough tackle.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
9' Andre Silva (Elche) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
8' Angel Perez (Alaves) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
7' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Alaves was in an offside position.
5' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) takes the corner.
4' A player from Alaves pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
3' Elche control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' Alaves are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
